name: kavsak
description: Mivelo — tüm mesajlaşma kanalların için yerel öncelikli, AI destekli tek gelen kutusu

scripts.dev: concurrently -n core,web -c magenta,green "npm run dev -w packages/core" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n core,web -c magenta,green "npm run demo -w packages/core" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.desktop: concurrently -n core,desktop -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w packages/core" "npm run dev -w apps/desktop"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
